mapper.sql: vouchers.id AS id, vouchers.branch_id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, vouchers.voucher_code AS voucherCode, vouchers.description AS description, vouchers.`date` AS `date`, vouchers.`start` AS startDate, vouchers.`end` AS endDate, vouchers.user_type AS userType, vouchers.voucher_type AS voucherType, vouchers.note AS note, vouchers.discount_amount AS discountAmount, vouchers.discount_percent AS discountPercent, vouchers.status AS status, vouchers.approved AS approved, CONCAT(IFNULL(approver.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(approver.last_name, '')) AS approvedBy, vouchers.created AS created, CONCAT(IFNULL(creator.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(creator.last_name, '')) AS createdBy, vouchers.modified AS modified, CONCAT(IFNULL(modifier.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(modifier.last_name, '')) AS modifiedBy

FROM vouchers LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = vouchers.branch_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = vouchers.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = vouchers.modified_by LEFT JOIN users AS approver ON approver.id = vouchers.approved_by

sql.if: AND ( vouchers.voucher_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR vouchers.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR vouchers.note LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM vouchers WHERE voucher_code = #{voucherCode} AND status != 0 AND id != #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vouchers ( branch_id, voucher_code, description, `date`, `start`, `end`, user_type, voucher_type, note, discount_amount, discount_percent, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{voucher.branchId}, #{voucher.voucherCode}, #{voucher.description}, #{voucher.date}, #{voucher.startDate}, #{voucher.endDate}, #{voucher.userType}, #{voucher.voucherType}, #{voucher.note}, #{voucher.discountAmount}, #{voucher.discountPercent}, NOW(), #{voucher.createdBy}, #{voucher.status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE vouchers SET branch_id = #{voucher.branchId}, voucher_code = #{voucher.voucherCode}, description = #{voucher.description}, `date` = #{voucher.date}, `start` = #{voucher.startDate}, `end` = #{voucher.endDate}, user_type = #{voucher.userType}, voucher_type = #{voucher.voucherType}, note = #{voucher.note}, discount_amount = #{voucher.discountAmount}, discount_percent = #{voucher.discountPercent}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{voucher.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{voucher.id} AND status != 0
UPDATE vouchers SET status = 0, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 0
